# What happens after a cut?

<!-- STEP id="hedge" -->
## A cut hedge

Gardeners often cut the hedge around a school garden flat on top. After some time, more branches appear, and the hedge becomes bushy.

<!-- STEP id="grass" -->
## Grass that grows back

Cows and goats graze on grass and eat the tops of the blades, and the grass on a cricket ground is mowed short. Yet after some time, the grass grows tall again.

<!-- STEP id="puzzle" -->
## The tips are gone

The apical meristems are at the tips, and these tips have been cut off or eaten.

**So where do the new cells for this regrowth come from?**
